assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: A circle with the self-intersecting hexagon ABCDEF inscribed. The lines AB, CD, EF are extended (dashed blue) to the triangle XYZ; the red points P = AB meet DE, Q = BC meet EF and R = CD meet FA lie on one red line.

difficulty_rationale: A classical olympiad theorem: the proof needs the idea of the auxiliary triangle formed by alternate sides, three applications of Menelaus with directed lengths, and three power-of-a-point cancellations.
